title: Payment of Wayfare Rentals Charges from Driver Earnings and the Card on File
content:
Each charge on a Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) rental is paid in the product's payment order: from the driver's earnings at the weekly deduction, as far as the available balance allows, and the rest by the card on file the day after. A payment always names the charge it pays, and the payments on a charge never exceed it.

## The rule broken down

| Input | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A rental charge is due at the weekly deduction | How much of the driver's available earnings balance is there? | The charge is paid from earnings up to that available balance |
| Part of the charge is still not covered by earnings | Is any of it left? | That remaining part is charged to the card on file the day after the weekly deduction |
| Any payment, from either source | Which charge does it pay? | It names that charge; earnings and card payments on one charge together never exceed that charge |

A payment from earnings appears on the rental as a payment against the named charge and, on the driver's side, as a rental deduction in Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro that refers to the same charge. A card payment appears on the rental as a payment against the named charge. What the driver still owes on the rental, the rental balance, is the charges booked less rebates, payments and deposit offsets.

## Charging at hub chargers

Charging at Wayfare hub chargers is included for the Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan, so it gives rise to no charge on that class.

## Hypothetical weekly charges

- A weekly charge of $269.00 meets an available earnings balance of $500.00 at the weekly deduction: $269.00 is paid from earnings and nothing is charged to the card.
- A weekly charge of $269.00 meets an available earnings balance of $200.00: $200.00 is paid from earnings, and the remaining $69.00 is charged to the card on file the day after the weekly deduction. The two payments name the same charge and total $269.00, the amount of the charge.
- A weekly charge of $269.00 meets an available earnings balance of nothing: the whole $269.00 is charged to the card on file the day after the weekly deduction.
